source_audit.finding: Public schedule and offline auction lists; model, mileage and starting bid visible. Exact detail requests for VW Tharu and Zeekr 009 redirected to buyer login requiring account/password/verification. No verified photos or reports or sale outcomes.
BMW X1 and Audi A4L have vehicle codes, mileage, grade and starting bid; both report pages explicitly state failed to fetch report. Not confirmed sales.
Public catalogue contains seller prices, not actual sale outcomes; inspected representative entries have no verified full report, no confirmed photo provenance.
Only two China lots in archive, Ford Explorer 2011 and Toyota RAV4 2016, Beijing US Embassy. No matched full inspection/closed hall verification.
Public page opens Korean Encar data in snapshot despite archive query; no China exact-lot verification.
Reports used by bidders in dealer app and auction hall under dealer agreement; public summaries not full matched media. Model transaction page timed out.
No readable public lot data in retrieved page; no original source reports verified.

notes: No new payments or contacts. Do not weaken exact-lot visual or document requirements. Use existing authorized dealer access or exported archive only when available; do not circumvent login.
